title: refactor: decompose complex scanning, diffing, and analysis functions
prompt:
refactor: decompose complex scanning, diffing, and analysis functions

Decompose long functions into modular private helpers:
- Split scan_diff in rulebook into docker user collection, hunk state reset, context line handling, and vulnerability checkers.
- Split _carry_string in code text into open string resumption and comment blanking while preserving scanning loop performance.
- Split get_diff in diff inspector into git diff execution and untracked file diff synthesis, maintaining exact error semantics.
- Split _read_scoped_files and _parse_llm_response in pre-analysis into path validation, file reading, and header/contract parsing helpers.

Files changed: guard/core/code_text.py, guard/core/diff_inspector.py, guard/core/rulebook.py, guard/domains/pre_analysis.py
